walk.title: Connect an agent
walk.body: Crissa answers through any agent that speaks the OpenAI chat-completions API: a model on this computer, a hosted API, or an agent's gateway. Fill in its address, key and model, then Test. You can also set it up later on the Connect page.

walk.title: Voice ID
walk.body: Four short recordings at this computer: the sentence on the screen and a count to six, each facing the camera and then turned away, each at its beep. Crissa learns your voice from them. They stay on this computer.
walk.body_verbal: Four short recordings at this computer, by ear: you hear a count to six, then count the same way at the beep, facing forward and then with your head turned a little to each side. Nothing to read. Your face photos are taken while you count. Crissa learns your voice from them. They stay on this computer.

walk.title: Face photos
walk.body: Look at the camera, then to the left, and Crissa takes a photo each time so she knows your face. The photos stay on this computer.
walk.no_camera: Crissa runs with no camera on this computer, so there are no face photos to take. She knows you by your voice.

walk.title: Your room
walk.body: The clock is your room seen from above: the camera is the middle of the clock and you are at 6 o'clock. Each mark starts at its default. Pick a mark, then tap its hour; change only what is different here, or skip.

wave.ask: Stand in the doorway and wave your right hand. Is that wave on the right of the picture?

one_line.say: Now label the main sound source and door location based on this diagram.
one_line.nudge: The camera in the middle is Crissa. The sound source is where media plays, like a TV or speakers, so she can filter it out. Then mark your door.

walk.title: Your hours
walk.body: Overnight is when Crissa does her own work while you are away. Quiet hours are when her announcements keep quiet. Keep the defaults, change them, or skip.

film_words.lila-ob-welcome: I'm Lila, the house designer. I'll take the next few minutes to set the house up with you.
film_words.lila-ob-seats: Where does each person usually sit?
film_words.lila-ob-sound-hour: Which hour on the clock are the speakers? Say it or tap it.
film_words.lila-ob-wave: Please stand in the doorway and wave your right hand. Is that wave on the right of the picture?
film_words.lila-ob-mirrored: Then the picture is mirrored. I've noted it. Wave once more.
film_words.lila-ob-overnight: Overnight, the house practices on its own, six in the evening to two in the morning, unless you'd like another window or say later.
film_words.lila-ob-manners: A couple more things about the house's manners. Are there hours it should keep quiet?
